description: Get the normalized render manifest (scene_assets[]) for the current scene — the artifacts a UI pairs with this scene: {kind: image|svg|equation_latex|plot_spec|code|data_csv|protocol_md|executed_result, title?, payload?, path?, legend?: [{symbol, meaning}], meta?}. Empty for a plain quiz. A webview calls this each turn to repaint the artifact pane in lockstep with the lesson. reference_result and executed_result are EVIDENCE to judge against, not an answer key.
name: get_scene_artifacts
